==About me==

Enthusiastic fan of the Wheel of Time. All hyped up after re-reading the entire series and attending the first JordanCon!

I'm also a big fan of Brandon Sanderson's ''Mistborn'' series. Between that and his talks at JordanCon, I'm feeling quite optimistic about the three volumes of ''A Memory of Light''.

Call me odd, but I enjoy adding little-known characters to the wiki. I figure it's rather useful. After all, they're the ones it's so hard to remember!
